title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Information Technology (2016)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Information Technology (2016). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: Project team has decided to use competent project personnel, using various analysis and validation techniques, and buying maintenance or service agreements from subcontractors. Which negative risk response strategy is the team using?
questions.explanation: The team is using risk mitigation by employing competent personnel and service agreements to reduce the probability/impact of risks.

questions.questionText: Identify a protocol that controls the manner in which Web pages are transferred back and forth between systems.
questions.explanation: HTTP is the protocol specifically designed for transferring web pages between servers and clients.

questions.questionText: Each value in a tuple must be an atomic in a relation, which one is the correct database design concept applied to avoid if composite attributes exists in relational model?
options: Composite attributes are denoted by separate relations
Multivalued attributes must be denoted by their simple component attributes
Multivalued attributes must be denoted along with the key attribute
Composite attributes are denoted by their simple component attributes
questions.explanation: In relational database design, composite attributes should be broken down into their simple (atomic) component attributes to satisfy 1NF.

questions.questionText: What tags are required for an HTML page?
questions.explanation: The minimum required tags for a valid HTML document are <html>, <head>, and <body>. The 'foot' tag doesn't exist in standard HTML. While modern browsers might render pages with missing required tags, they're technically required for valid HTML.

questions.questionText: One of the following can categorizes as a collection of principles that form the foundation of object-oriented design?
questions.explanation: The object model is the conceptual framework for object-oriented programming, containing principles like encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.

questions.questionText: In Linux, user's encrypted password is kept in.
questions.explanation: Modern Linux systems store encrypted passwords in /etc/shadow for security, while /etc/passwd contains user information without passwords.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is correct about the Transmission Control Protocol (TCP)?
options: TCP allows for error detection and correction.
TCP allows for retransmission of lost segments.
questions.explanation: TCP provides reliable communication through features like error detection and retransmission of lost segments. Unlike UDP which is connectionless, TCP is connection-oriented and ensures data delivery through acknowledgments and retransmission of lost packets.

questions.questionText: You can define a new class from an existing class. The new class is called
questions.explanation: In object-oriented programming, when you create a new class from an existing one, it's called an extended class or subclass.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an element of object-oriented paradigm that does not used to solve any problem?
questions.explanation: Functional decomposition is a procedural programming concept, not an object-oriented principle.

questions.questionText: The data model that develop a database as a collection of tables, where each table can be stored as a separate file.
questions.explanation: The relational model organizes data into tables (relations) which can be stored separately.

questions.questionText: The reusable portion of the app's UI is referred to as
questions.explanation: In Android development, Fragments represent reusable portions of UI that can be combined in Activities.

questions.questionText: The conditional statement Not (x >= 5) returns true if the value of x = ?
questions.explanation: Not(x >= 5) is true when x is less than 5, so x=4 satisfies this condition.

questions.questionText: What is the default bridge priority for all STP switches?
questions.explanation: The default bridge priority in Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) is 32,768.

questions.questionText: A systems in which it may make sense to use traditional file processing, instead of a database approach
options: Embedded systems with unlimited storage capacity
Applications that are not expected to change at all
questions.explanation: Simple, unchanging applications might not need the complexity of a DBMS and can use file processing.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following project scope management processes is a crucial part of many IT projects?
questions.explanation: Collecting requirements is fundamental to IT projects to ensure the developed system meets user needs.

questions.questionText: The function procedures are by default.
questions.explanation: In most programming languages, functions/procedures are public by default unless specified otherwise.

questions.questionText: is a property of a transaction which ensures changes must not be lost because of any failure.
questions.explanation: Durability in ACID properties ensures committed transactions persist even after system failures.

questions.questionText: Unsolicited commercial email is known as
questions.explanation: Unsolicited bulk emails are commonly referred to as spam.

questions.explanation: Cardinality ratio specifies the maximum number of relationship instances an entity can participate in.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a type of independent malicious program that never required any host program?
questions.explanation: Worms are standalone malware that don't need to attach to a host program.

questions.questionText: SetFocus is a method which moves the focus to the specified control or form.
questions.explanation: SetFocus is the method used to move input focus to a specific control in many programming frameworks.

questions.questionText: Content Provider enables sending of data from an application to another application
questions.explanation: In Android, Content Providers enable data sharing between applications.

questions.questionText:
Consider the following database table called Drinks, it has three columns (Name, Type, and Price):



| Drinks      | Type          | Price |

|-------------|---------------|-------|

| Pepsi       | Soft Drink    | 35    |

| Tea         | Hot Beverage  | 25    |

| Coca cola   | Soft Drink    | 35    |



Which SQL statement shows the total number of soft drinks?
options: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Drinks WHERE Type= 'Soft Drink'
SELECT Type FROM DRINKS WHERE SUM()
SELECT Name, Type, Price FROM Drinks WHERE Type='Soft Drinks' and SUM()
questions.explanation: To count the number of soft drinks, use COUNT(*) with a WHERE clause filtering for the 'Soft Drink' type. The other options have syntax errors or incorrect function usage.

questions.questionText: Which tool can be utilized to examine a packet capture?
questions.explanation: Wireshark is a popular network protocol analyzer for examining packet captures.

questions.questionText: Which of the communication modes support two way traffic but in only one direction of a time?
questions.explanation: Half-duplex allows two-way communication but only one direction at a time (like walkie-talkies).

questions.questionText: In what circumstances does the EIGRP protocol advertise the whole database?
options: When a route update is sent
questions.explanation: EIGRP sends full routing table only when establishing adjacency with a new neighbor.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following project quality management involves evaluating overall project performance relevant to quality standards?
questions.explanation: Quality assurance involves evaluating overall performance against quality standards.

questions.questionText: For every enum, the compiler generates a static method called that returns an array of the enum's constants in the order in which they were declared.
questions.explanation: The values() method is automatically generated for enums to return all constants.

questions.questionText: Which routing method uses the least amount of RAM on the router?
questions.explanation: Static routing consumes minimal RAM as it doesn't maintain routing tables or neighbor relationships.

questions.questionText: select TCP/IP Protocol for the remote terminal connection service.
questions.explanation: TELNET is the TCP/IP protocol specifically designed for remote terminal connections.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not a valid way to alter the size of an element?
questions.explanation: "ft" is not a valid CSS unit for sizing elements. Valid CSS units include px, em, rem, %, cm, etc. Additionally, option B had a syntax error in the original question with a missing colon after 'height'.

questions.questionText: Which of the subsequent operators creates instances of exceptions that can be thrown using throw?
questions.explanation: The 'new' operator is used to create exception objects that can be thrown.

questions.questionText: The maximum distance that 1000Base-T supports is
questions.explanation: 1000Base-T (Gigabit Ethernet over copper) has a maximum segment length of 100 meters.

questions.questionText: Keywords in Visual Basic are words that
options: Are used to name controls, such as TextBox1, Command1 etc.
Are used as prefixes for control names (such as btn, lbl, and lst).
Should be used when naming variables.
Have special meaning and should not be used when naming variables.
questions.explanation: Keywords in VB have special meaning (like Dim, Sub, Function) and shouldn't be used as variable names.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not considered a system component that can be found inside a computer?
questions.explanation: While a PCIe graphics adapter is an important component, it's an expansion card that can be added/removed, not considered one of the core/essential system components like CPU, motherboard, and RAM that are required for a computer to function at the most basic level.

questions.questionText: Which command is wrong to add a new user to the system?
questions.explanation: "addLinux" is not a standard Linux command for adding users.

questions.questionText: In the name http://moe.edu.et/news.html, the moe.edu.et part is called.
questions.explanation: moe.edu.et is the hostname (domain name) portion of the URL.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is not true?
options: class that extends the Thread class can create a thread
Only by implementing the Runnable interface may a thread be created
In specific circumstances, the run() method is used before the start() method to start a thread
The thread's execution is started using the start() method
questions.explanation: Threads can be created both by extending Thread class or implementing Runnable interface.

questions.questionText: decides the priority of the thread execution.
questions.explanation: The thread scheduler determines which thread gets CPU time based on priorities.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid code to delete cookie named user?
questions.explanation: In PHP, setting cookie with past expiration time (time()-3600) effectively deletes it.

questions.explanation: The script calculates: $array[$array[0]]=array[1]=3, $array[$array[1]]=array[3]=8, $array[$array[2]]=array[5]=21, $array[$array[3]]=array[8]=34, $array[$array[4]]=array[13]=12 (last index is undefined in the array, which PHP treats as 0 or null depending on version). So 3+8+21+34+12=78.

questions.questionText: Consider a design of web form to upload your assignment which has no limit to the size of its content. Which method will be used for this functionality?
questions.explanation: POST method is used for submitting data, especially large amounts like file uploads.

questions.questionText: You are installing a new power supply in a desktop computer. Which of the following statements about power supplies is true?
options: Power supplies convert AC input to DC output
You must make sure that the voltage selector switch on the back of the power supply is switched to the lower setting if the computer is going to be used in Europe.
Power supplies require a 20-pin to 24-pin motherboard adapter to supply power to ATX-based motherboards.
SATA hard drives most often use the same type of power connector that PATA hard drives use.
questions.explanation: Computer power supplies convert AC wall current to various DC voltages needed by components.

questions.questionText: TCP/IP layer corresponds to the three top layers of OSI reference model layers.
questions.explanation: The TCP/IP Application layer corresponds to OSI's Application, Presentation, and Session layers.

questions.questionText: In public key encryption system, if A encrypts a message using his private key and sends it to B. Which statement will be true?
options: Even if B knows who sent the message it cannot be decrypted
It cannot be decrypted at all as no one knows A's private key
If B knows it is from A he can decrypt it using A's public key
should send his public key with the message
questions.explanation: Messages encrypted with private key can be decrypted with corresponding public key (used for digital signatures).

questions.questionText: Which layer is responsible for compression and decompression?
questions.explanation: The Presentation layer (OSI Layer 6) handles data translation including compression/decompression.

questions.questionText: Which HTML tag is used to define an internal style sheet?
questions.explanation: <style> tags are used for internal CSS within an HTML document.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT typically outlined as a security practice for personal computer users?
questions.explanation: While updating product security is important, it's often handled through automatic updates by vendors rather than being emphasized as a primary user security practice like using antivirus, strong passwords, and backups. This answer is subjective and may vary based on different security frameworks.

questions.questionText: Which type of cable would be used to connect a computer to a switch for management of the switch?
questions.explanation: Rollover/console cables are used for switch management via console ports.

questions.questionText: Create a textbox which accepts a maximum of 20 character with default value 'Mango'
questions.explanation: maxlength limits input to 20 chars, value sets default text. Other options have syntax errors.

questions.questionText: control events to execute at a specified intervals of time.
questions.explanation: Timer controls are used to trigger events at regular intervals in programming.

questions.questionText: Asc('A') is 65. What is the output of txtBox.Text = Chr(65) & "BC"?
questions.explanation: Chr(65) returns 'A', concatenated with 'BC' gives 'ABC'.

questions.questionText: Which of the following variable is invalid?
questions.explanation: Variable names cannot contain spaces. '$J If' is invalid.

questions.questionText: present an outside view on the manner that the elements in a system behave and how they can be used in the context.
questions.explanation: Use case diagrams show system functionality from an external/user perspective.

questions.questionText: A candidate key that is chosen by the database designer as the principal means to identify a particular entity from an entity set is called.
questions.explanation: The primary key is the selected candidate key used to uniquely identify records.

questions.questionText: Which of the following types of processors will likely, generally, be preferred for mobile devices?
questions.explanation: ARM processors dominate mobile devices due to power efficiency.

questions.questionText: Which iterative control can guarantee the code to be processed at least once?
questions.explanation: do...while checks condition after execution, ensuring at least one iteration.

questions.questionText: Which of the following Linux command is appropriate to change the user password?
questions.explanation: passwd is the standard Linux command for changing passwords.

questions.questionText: Why routing tables used administrative distances?
options: Administrative distances define reliability of routing protocols
Administrative distances allow for the shortest distance between routes
Administrative distances are programmed by the administrator for path selection
questions.explanation: Administrative distance indicates route trustworthiness (lower = more reliable).

questions.explanation: Virtual machine abstraction groups operations that perform similar functions.

questions.questionText: The proper order of OSI reference model layers are. (from higher to lower)
options: Application, Presentation, Transport, Network, Session, Data link, Physical
Presentation, Application, Session, Transport, Network, Data Link, Physical
Application, Presentation, Session, Transport, Network, Data Link, Physical
Application, Transport, Session, Presentation, Network, Data Link, Physical
questions.explanation: Correct OSI layers from top: Application, Presentation, Session, Transport, Network, Data Link, Physical.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not necessary to demonstrate before you run a Java program?
options: Compile programming statements to machine language.
Write program statements that correspond to the logic.
questions.explanation: Debugging is optional, while the other steps are required to run a Java program.

questions.questionText: The process by which the processor slows down to conserve power is officially called
questions.explanation: CPU throttling reduces clock speed to save power/heat.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is true regarding HTML, CSS and JavaScript?
options: CSS is for structuring as HTML is for styling
HTML is for structuring as JavaScript is for behavior/functionality
CSS is for structuring, HTML for styling and JavaScript is for behavior/Functionality
CSS is for styling, HTML for structuring and JavaScript is for behavior/Functionality
questions.explanation: HTML structures content, CSS styles it, JavaScript adds behavior.

questions.questionText: Identify the wrong statement regarding variables in android application development.
options: To access characters directly as numbers we can toInt() function
Variables defined as var is an object whose state cannot be changed after instantiation
String can be accessed as an array and can be iterated

questions.questionText: Which type of port removes the VLAN ID from the frame before it egresses the interface?
questions.explanation: Access ports strip VLAN tags as they connect to end devices.

questions.questionText: A flaw or weakness in an information asset, security procedure, design, or control that could be exploited accidentally or on purpose to breach security is known as

questions.questionText: Among the following, which class can handle all exceptions that cannot be handled?
questions.explanation: The Error class represents serious problems that a reasonable application should not try to catch. Exception is the superclass for exceptions that can be handled, while Error is for unrecoverable conditions.

questions.questionText: What value will be assigned to the numeric variable x when the statement x = 2 * 3 + 4 is executed?
questions.explanation: Following operator precedence rules, multiplication happens before addition: 2*3=6, then 6+4=10. This gives us the final result of 10.

questions.questionText: You are IT project manager for your organization and you're working to ensure that quality is maintained throughout the project execution. What must every project have to ensure the work in the project sticks to a standard of quality?

budget with plenty of cash reserve
